quality_effect: Prevents treating HMLR general-boundary red edging as an exact legal or survey line; no standard tolerance may be inferred.
verified_facts: Most registered titles show general boundaries
There is no standard tolerance measurement or ratio between the mapped general boundary and legal boundary
Title plans must be read with the register
All title plans show general boundaries unless determined under section 60
Title plan purpose is the general extent of registered land
Title plans are based on OS mapping current when registered
Undefined boundaries can be shown using pecked lines
Deed dimensions do not convert a general boundary into an exact boundary
General-boundary interpretation uses pre-registration deeds plus OS detail
Determined boundaries are distinct from general boundaries
